name: How Injection Molding Works
title: How Injection Molding Works

name: Wall Thickness
title: Wall Thickness
description: Uniform wall thickness is the golden rule: thick sections sink, thin sections don't fill, transitions cause stress. Uniformity prevents most molding defects.

key_points: Uniform walls prevent sinks and stress.
